title: Mirendil, founded by former Anthropic researchers to build tools for frontier AI R&D, raised a $1B Series A led by Kleiner Perkins and Clearlake Capital (Sarah Klearman/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Sarah Klearman / Wall Street Journal: Mirendil, founded by former Anthropic researchers to build tools for frontier AI R&D, raised a $1B Series A led by Kleiner Perkins and Clearlake Capital — The fundraise comes six months after Mirendil, founded by Anthropic alumni, announced a $200 million seed round
